message.content: I'll search for the best way to change a `` color on mouseover using HTML/CSS. web_search CSS span hover change color mouseover Based on my search, here's how to change a `` element's color on mouse over using CSS: ## Pure CSS Solution (Recommended) The simplest and most performant approach uses the `:hover` pseudo-class: ```html Hover over this text! ``` ## Key Points | Aspect | Details | |--------|---------| | **Selector** | `.class:hover` or `span:hover` | | **No JavaScript needed** | CSS handles everything | | **Performance** | Hardware-accelerated, no reflows | ## Alternative: Inline Style (Not Recommended) If you must use inline styles (limited flexibility): ```html Hover me ``` ## Why CSS `:hover` is Better Than JavaScript - **Cleaner separation** of concerns (style vs. behavior) - **Better performance** (no event handling overhead) - **Easier maintenance** — change colors in one place - **Handles edge cases** automatically (mouse leaving element, touch devices, etc.) ## Additional Styling Options ```css span.interactive { color: #333; cursor: pointer; /* Shows it's interactive */ text-decoration: none; /* Remove underline if needed */ } span.interactive:hover { color: #007bff; /* Common link blue */ text-decoration: underline; } ``` The CSS `:hover` pseudo-class is universally supported in all modern browsers and IE7+. Sources: 1. https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/:hover 2. https://www.w3schools.com/cssref/sel_hover.asp 3. https://css-tricks.com/almanac/selectors/h/hover/
